input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

This scene:
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When the flower appears, add one visual detail to make the setting easier to imagine: “那儿开着金黄色的花，像星星一样。”
2. After drinking the tea, show Shennong’s physical reaction and feeling: “他觉得肚子疼了起来，心里很害怕。”
3. Add a short thought to show his uncertainty: “这种茶不是很有用吗？为什么我这么难受？”

ideas.reason: It adds a clear visual detail to the yellow flowers without changing the event.
It makes his stated discomfort more concrete and shows an appropriate reaction.
It adds a simple, natural thought that fits his surprise at feeling ill after drinking the tea.
